_about: The two courses. Each models a public range. plates lists each steel plate: its distance, its width and height in inches, how high its centre stands above the eye at the firing position (riseFt, surveyed, used by the engine and every picture alike) and where it stands sideways (lateralYd, placed by angle as seen from the firing line). altitudeFt is the surveyed height of the firing position above sea level, for the air. firing is where the shooter stands and which way the line of fire runs, on the surveyed ground of data/terrain.json. blurb is the one line home shows about the course.

firing._about: The firing position and the direction of fire on the surveyed ground: the shooter's place under the shelter, in NAD83 / UTM zone 11N metres (the frame of data/terrain.json) and as latitude and longitude; the bearing is degrees from north, clockwise. The picture's camera stands here; every plate is placed from here.

lat.estimate: latitude of the firing position: the long roofed shelter at the mouth of the side canyon north of the canyon road, read off the NAIP photograph of 2022-05-04 (the roof runs east-north-east to west-south-west, 7 m west and 4 m south of the range's public map position); the direction of fire is square to the roof, up the side canyon

lon.estimate: longitude of the firing position, the same basis

easting.estimate: UTM easting of the firing position, the same basis; read against the photograph's own grid (data/terrain.json, cta-piru.photo)

bearingDeg.estimate: the bearing of fire in degrees from north: square to the shelter's roof as it lies on the photograph of 2022-05-04, and along the side canyon's floor
